Competencies

Show indicators at

Showing the L3 indicator for each competency. Open a competency to see all five levels.

  • Evaluation of data visualization7.1.1

    L1 Awareness

    Recognise good and bad practice in pharma figures (axis abuse, misleading scales, chart-junk, accessibility issues).

    L2 Familiarity

    Apply an evaluation checklist to an existing pharma figure.

    L3 Proficiency

    Evaluate pharma figures critically against purpose, audience, and standards.

    L4 Mastery

    Lead figure review for a pharma project or publication, with substantive feedback.

    L5 Expertise

    Set the team's evaluation standards.

  • Critiqueing data visualization7.1.2

    L1 Awareness

    Recognise that critique is a craft, not just opinion.

    L2 Familiarity

    Give structured critique on a pharma figure following a template.

    L3 Proficiency

    Provide actionable critique on real pharma figures, balancing form and message.

    L4 Mastery

    Coach others to critique well; resolve disagreements between figure authors and stakeholders.

    L5 Expertise

    Set the team's critique culture.

  • Doing data visualization7.1.3

    L1 Awareness

    Recognise the basic chart types and when each is appropriate.

    L2 Familiarity

    Make a competent pharma chart (KM curve, forest plot, waterfall) using ggplot2 / matplotlib following an example.

    L3 Proficiency

    Produce publication- or report-grade pharma figures end-to-end with appropriate annotations and uncertainty.

    L4 Mastery

    Design figure systems for non-trivial pharma communication (style guide, interactive dashboards, accessibility).

    L5 Expertise

    Set the team's visualisation standards or contribute open-source tooling.

Pharma examples

Each example is tagged with the competency and level it shows. Tags open that level.

  • A pre-trial figure mockup that forces clarification of the primary outcomeDoing data visualization L3
  • A survival KM plot with risk table that meets journal expectationsDoing data visualization L3
  • A team style guide for pharma figures (palette, typography, accessibility)Critiqueing data visualization L4Doing data visualization L5

Typical stack

R ggplot2, plotly, gt/gtsummary; Python matplotlib, seaborn, altair, plotly; design tools (Figma) at higher levels; accessibility checks.
